title: Mycota Lab CTAB Protocol
author: Stephen D Douglas Russell
materials: Create your stock Proteinase K and RNASE A solutions. Both at 20mg / mL. So for 100mg of Proteinase K, add 5 mL of molecular water. Same for the RNASE A.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the CTAB buffer in 50mL tubes, adding 500 uL per sample. For 96 samples, use 48mL of CTAB and add 240 uL of Proteinase K and 240 uL of RNASE A.

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Place fungal tissue and a stainless steel bead into a 1.5mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1mL of prewarmed (65°C) CTAB extraction buffer containing proteinase K (1 mg/mL) and RNase A (10 mg/mL).

steps.title: Freeze-Thaw and Incubate
steps.instruction: Perform three rounds of freeze-thaw and a final incubation.

substeps.instruction: Alternate three-minute treatments in dry ice and a 70°C heating block for three rounds.
Incubate at 70°C for 30 minutes to overnight.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples for 10 minutes at max speed.

steps.title: Phase Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the liquid phase to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: First Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first organic extraction to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Invert the tube 15 times to mix.

steps.title: Second Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second extraction to further purify the sample.

substeps.instruction: Move the upper liquid phase to a new 1.5mL tube.
Invert the tube 15 times to mix.
Add ice-cold isopropanol (2/3 of the recovered volume).

steps.title: Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol twice.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 10,000 rpm and pour off the ethanol.
Repeat the wash process a second time.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in water.

substeps.instruction: Let the pellet air dry for at least 15 minutes or until all ethanol has evaporated.
Resuspend the pellet in 20uL of molecular water.

steps.title: Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a final cleanup using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 20uL of beads to the tube and wait 5 minutes.
Place on magnet for 2 minutes and remove the liquid.
Add 125mL of ethanol, wait 2 minutes, and remove the ethanol.
